title: DocumentRevision
description: One immutable revision of a role-owned document. Revisions are never edited in place; publishing is validated by the core against ownership, current primary instance identity, generation and expected_revision.

role_id.description: Owning role. Cross-role impersonation is rejected: the trusted session identity must match this owner for publish.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing per (workspace_id, role_id, document_key), starting at 1.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the revision body; bodies live in the content-addressed output area.

visibility.description: project: readable by all roles in the workspace. role: readable within the owning role. private: readable by the owning instance only. Reads outside visibility are rejected.

created_by_instance_id.description: Primary instance that published this revision; old-generation instances cannot appear here.
